events.title: Rouen surrenders to Henry V
events.description: After a six-month siege that left thousands starving, Rouen yielded to Henry V of England, completing his conquest of Normandy. The Treaty of Troyes in 1420 made him heir to the French throne.
events.html: After a six-month siege that left thousands starving, Rouen yielded to Henry V of England, completing his conquest of Normandy. The Treaty of Troyes in 1420 made him heir to the French throne.

events.title: Verdi's 'Il trovatore' premieres in Rome
events.description: Giuseppe Verdi's opera of passion and revenge opened at the Teatro Apollo to great acclaim. With 'Rigoletto' and 'La traviata', it is one of the three popular masterpieces of his middle period.
events.html: Giuseppe Verdi's opera of passion and revenge opened at the Teatro Apollo to great acclaim. With 'Rigoletto' and 'La traviata', it is one of the three popular masterpieces of his middle period.

events.title: Zeppelins bomb Britain for the first time
events.description: German airships dropped bombs on Great Yarmouth, Sheringham and King's Lynn in Norfolk, killing four civilians. It was the first air raid on Britain, opening a new front in the war.
events.html: German airships dropped bombs on Great Yarmouth, Sheringham and King's Lynn in Norfolk, killing four civilians. It was the first air raid on Britain, opening a new front in the war.

events.title: Zimmermann Telegram is forwarded to Mexico
events.description: Germany's ambassador in Washington relayed Arthur Zimmermann's secret offer of an alliance to Mexico, promising Texas, New Mexico and Arizona. Decoded by British intelligence, its publication helped bring the US into the war.
events.html: Germany's ambassador in Washington relayed Arthur Zimmermann's secret offer of an alliance to Mexico, promising Texas, New Mexico and Arizona. Decoded by British intelligence, its publication helped bring the US into the war.

events.title: Howard Hughes sets a transcontinental air speed record
events.description: Hughes flew his H-1 racer from Burbank, California, to Newark, New Jersey, in 7 hours, 28 minutes and 25 seconds. The record stood for seven years.
events.html: Hughes flew his H-1 racer from Burbank, California, to Newark, New Jersey, in 7 hours, 28 minutes and 25 seconds. The record stood for seven years.

events.title: Indira Gandhi chosen to lead India
events.description: The Congress parliamentary party elected Indira Gandhi as its leader after the sudden death of Lal Bahadur Shastri. Sworn in five days later, she became India's first and only woman prime minister.
events.html: The Congress parliamentary party elected Indira Gandhi as its leader after the sudden death of Lal Bahadur Shastri. Sworn in five days later, she became India's first and only woman prime minister.

events.title: Apple announces the Lisa computer
events.description: Apple unveiled the Lisa, a personal computer with a graphical interface and a mouse. At nearly 10,000 dollars it sold poorly, but its ideas fed directly into the Macintosh a year later.
